# Oxygen

Oxygen gives the Minimal theme a calm, focus-first color palette with animations and transitions across panes, modals and menus. Custom color presets can be created, imported and shared, and Style Settings support is provided for further customization.

![Oxygen screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/davidvkimball/obsidian-oxygen/HEAD/theme-cover.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Oxygen"
    author: "David V. Kimball"
    repo:   "davidvkimball/obsidian-oxygen"
    slug:   "oxygen"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/oxygen"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/davidvkimball/obsidian-oxygen"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/davidvkimball/obsidian-oxygen/HEAD/theme-cover.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply Oxygen to give Minimal a calm, focus-first color palette with polished animations and subtle transitions across panes, modals, and menus. Create, import, and share custom color presets and use full Style Settings support for deep visual customization."
}
```
